text: benchmarks/runs/dna-1024.fa is the suite's normal DNA fixture at 1024 MiB: 24 records, 6 distinct bytes, made 2026-11-05 with -s 1024. long-repeats-10.fa and long-repeats-100.fa beside it are ten copies of a unit. At 276640b, 8 threads, one run, default budget, create --dna takes 9.1 s and 2381 MiB peak on dna-1024.fa, 0.22 s on long-repeats-10.fa and 3.2 s on long-repeats-100.fa.
